entities.summary: August Franciszek Maria Anna Józef Kajetan Czartoryski, SDB, was a Polish prince who was born in Paris during his family's exile, his constant frail health saw much of his childhood being shuttled to various health spas. Raphael Kalinowski tutored him; the prince turned to the priesthood instead of pursuing the aristocratic life.
